adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes the `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` type from a single object/null to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` (see `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts` and `packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`), and updates webhook E2E expectations from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`). In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is now constructed as an array (or `null`) and later persisted by connecting only the first element (`evt.destinationCalendar[0]`). If webhook payloads spread `evt`, subscribers will observe this shape change without any back-compat layer shown in the diff. This is a concrete, diff-grounded API/contract-breaking concern, though not necessarily a functional correctness bug inside the repo.
